seo.title: BioPlex 2200 ANA Screen | LabWell
seo.description: Explore the Bio-Rad ANA Screen panel for BioPlex 2200, review the manufacturer-listed analytes, and contact LabWell about a laboratory solution.

hero.lead: Bio-Rad lists the autoantibodies included in its ANA Screen panel for BioPlex 2200. Review the panel and its instrument here.

items: ANA Screen: dsDNA, Chromatin, Ribosomal Protein, SS-A (52 and 60), SS-B, Sm, Sm/RNP, RNP (A and 68), Scl-70, Jo-1, Centromere B

equipment.text: Bio-Rad identifies the BioPlex 2200 system for these panels.

items.q: What is included in the ANA Screen panel?
items.a: The panel contents above follow the Bio-Rad manufacturer material.

items.q: Which instrument is used for this panel?
items.a: Bio-Rad associates this panel with the BioPlex 2200 system; follow the instrument link to learn more.

items.q: How can I discuss a solution for my laboratory?
items.a: Send an inquiry to LabWell using the form on this page.

T12_contact.text: LabWell is the official distributor of Snibe and Bio-Rad in Ukraine. Send an inquiry and we will help you choose a solution.
